senses.example: Hun ser stort på reglerne og gør, hvad hun vil.
senses.example_translation: She ignores the rules and does what she wants.

senses.example_translation: I'm sitting out this time.

senses.example_translation: We are facing a major challenge.

senses.example: Jeg holder mig til de regler, vi har aftalt.
senses.example_translation: I am sticking to the rules we have agreed.

senses.example: Projektet gik frem hurtigere end forventet.
senses.example_translation: The project progressed faster than expected.

senses.example: Salget gik frem med ti procent sidste år.
senses.example_translation: Sales increased by ten percent last year.

senses.example: Bilen kører ind i garagen.
senses.example_translation: The car drives into the garage.

senses.example_translation: The money was enough for the whole month.

senses.example_translation: She accepted immediately.

senses.example: Jeg sætter pris på din hjælp.
senses.example_translation: I appreciate your help.

senses.example_translation: You must gather yourself and finish the job.

senses.example: Han steg op ad trappen til anden sal.
senses.example_translation: He ascended the stairs to the second floor.

senses.text: to open someone's eyes (to the truth)
senses.example: Hun åbnede øjnene på mig for problemet.
senses.example_translation: She opened my eyes to the problem.

senses.example: Det var en svær tid, men vi kom igennem den sammen.
senses.example_translation: It was a difficult time, but we got through it together.

senses.example_translation: I hope I get through the exam tomorrow.

senses.example_translation: They broke up after five years together.

senses.example: Hun skrev hjem om sin nye lejlighed.
senses.example_translation: She wrote home about her new apartment.

senses.example: Jeg søger efter mine nøgler overalt.
senses.example_translation: I search for my keys everywhere.

senses.example_translation: The thief ran off with my bag.

senses.example: Børnene løber rundt i haven hele dagen.
senses.example_translation: The children run around in the garden all day.

senses.example_translation: I look for my keys everywhere.

senses.example_translation: The car stops in front of the traffic lights.

senses.example_translation: She points to the board with a long stick.

senses.example_translation: The passengers boarded the plane an hour before departure.

senses.example_translation: We eat out every Friday.

senses.example_translation: They fight against injustice every day.

senses.example_translation: The host offered coffee and cake.

senses.example_translation: I am happy about the good weather today.

senses.example_translation: She sang for her family at the birthday party.

senses.example_translation: She sets the table with plates and glasses.

senses.example_translation: The cat hides under the table.

senses.example_translation: We are preparing for a long winter.

senses.example_translation: I think you went too far with that comment.

senses.example_translation: The king went to war against the neighboring country.

senses.example: De har sex hver aften.
senses.example_translation: They have sex every evening.

senses.text: to have a screw loose (be slightly crazy)
senses.example: Jeg tror, han har en skrue løs, for han taler hele tiden med sig selv.
senses.example_translation: I think he has a screw loose, because he talks to himself all the time.

senses.example: Nogen har sat ild til skuret bag huset.
senses.example_translation: Someone has set fire to the shed behind the house.

senses.example: Han hoppede på tilbuddet med det samme.
senses.example_translation: He jumped at the offer immediately.

senses.example_translation: Guests can help themselves from the buffet throughout the evening.

senses.example: Børnene skynder sig hjem efter skole.
senses.example_translation: The children rush home after school.

senses.text: to be in the habit of (doing something)
senses.example: Jeg har for vane at drikke kaffe om morgenen.
senses.example_translation: I have a habit of drinking coffee in the morning.

senses.example: De to drenge pønser på en hemmelig plan.
senses.example_translation: The two boys are hatching a secret plan.

senses.example_translation: The path meanders through the forest.

senses.example_translation: She is homesick when she is on holiday.

senses.example_translation: She agreed to help us over the weekend.

senses.example: Hunden løb fra sin ejer i parken.
senses.example_translation: The dog ran away from its owner in the park.

senses.example: Han løb fra aftalen i sidste øjeblik.
senses.example_translation: He backed out of the deal at the last minute.
